entry.name: trough
entry.digest: Output a number if it is less than previous numbers
entry.description: Compares an input value to the stored value and, if it's smaller it sends the input to the output and sets it as the new trough.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The initial value stored inis. Providing a float argument will cause trough to operate on floating-point values instead of integers.
